title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_the_phantom_atlas_by_edward_brooke_hitching_d193b (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_the_phantom_atlas_by_edward_brooke_hitching_d193b' contains malicious code that fully compromises any computer on which it is installed or run. It can lead to complete system takeover, and all secrets and keys stored on the affected machine should be rotated immediately from a different device. Removal of the package does not guarantee elimination of all resulting malicious software.
